forecast_changes: none; diagnostic audit only, not a backdated forecast
purpose: Matched TimesFM3 univariate versus nine-variate CPI test and native probabilistic scoring
input: Same frozen CPI year-on-year values, same context dates and lengths; nine-series adds the existing eight CPI categories only
origins: 9 March, June, September and December in each year 2015-2025; 44 origins already inspected in prior work
cutoff: Origin calendar month minus two months, identical across variants; latest-vintage observations with proxy release lags
primary_probability_metric: WIS over native deciles 0.1 through 0.9; central intervals 20%,40%,60%,80%; no post-hoc recalibration or sorting
uncertainty: 5000 bootstrap samples of whole origin years; paired delta(MAE) and delta(WIS); pointwise exploratory 95% intervals, not confirmatory multiple-test significance
reproduction: Recompute old nine-series historical point outputs and compare max absolute difference; preserve any drift instead of silently overriding
integrity: No institutional forecasts enter models. Retain all failed gates. Raw native monthly quantiles are not annual quantiles. No winner-selected ensemble.
limitations: Previously inspected history is not untouched holdout
Foundation-model pretraining overlap not ruled out
